defectPopulationRecords.title: Managed current workspace-host cut rejects its materialized source as dirty at sidecar preflight

rootCauseVerification.hypothesis: Mapping-only source enumeration omitted a committed nested-app gitlink and falsely admitted an incomplete source.
rootCauseVerification.testResult: Old source refused by missing mapping; corrected physical source materializes the app and records sourceDirty=false. Existing56 canonical regression cases pass.
rootCauseVerification.testProcedure: Old immutable073913 has apps/slack-asana-bug-drill gitlinkf69bb1aa with no committed path/url; physical directory empty; admission exit3 names path despite empty ordinary tracked status. Correctedcc281 physical cut inspected model-preflight/materialize and emitter identity/capture, after all5 tested file hashes match commit.
rootCauseVerification.actualObservation: Corrected app contains pinned files, exact sourceRoot/cc281 identity has sourceDirty=false, dirty capture files=[]; old-source guard names missing app mapping. Separate model pack crypto verification ready.
rootCauseVerification.distinguishingTest: Compare failed pinned gitlinks/mappings/physical app, run full-population admission on old and corrected commits, then inspect actual corrected source capture.
rootCauseVerification.alternativeHypothesis: Ordinary tracked edits or an incorrectly selected provenance root caused the dirty-source refusal.

predictedObservations.hypothesis: Old source refuses by named missing mapping; corrected mapping materializes app and yields clean actual capture.
predictedObservations.alternativeHypothesis: A tracked dirty file or wrong-root identity remains and correcting mapping does not yield a clean emitter verdict.

defectPopulationRecords.title: Git-sync stages nested repositories as unmapped gitlinks

rootCauseVerification.hypothesis: git-sync accepted successfully staged mode160000 entries without inspecting commit-index .gitmodules, so an unmapped nested repository entered the committed source.
rootCauseVerification.testResult: Historical source has no mapping. New guard holds unmapped or working-tree-only entries; accepts indexed valid mapping even when working-tree metadata differs; retains ordinary file when invalid gitlink is unstaged; rejects malformed config and index-read failure. Existing193 cases pass.
rootCauseVerification.testProcedure: Historical49a/073913 contain app gitlinkf69bb1aa with no .gitmodules entry (existing root investigation). Six conventional Vitest tests create real Git object/index fixtures and measure unmapped holding, exact indexed metadata, pairing, removal, unrelated work retention and errors. Existing193-case git-sync suite confirms integration; corrected6case pass uses final code.
rootCauseVerification.actualObservation: Unmapped historical link measured in root repair; final real-index regression suite6passed and existing git-sync193passed. Root materialization separately repaired and actual source capture clean.
rootCauseVerification.distinguishingTest: Read actual committed app gitlink/mapping and exercise real Git indexes with absent, working-tree-only, indexed and malformed .gitmodules through the existing pre-commit guard.
rootCauseVerification.alternativeHypothesis: The committed gitlink had a valid path/url mapping but release materialization misinterpreted it.

predictedObservations.hypothesis: Historical commit lacks mapping; a guard consulting the exact index rejects that link, while a properly mapped index passes.
predictedObservations.alternativeHypothesis: Historical commit contains a valid mapping and the same indexed mapping is refused, locating the failure at materialization instead.
